             ("rimebell-refuge", "last", "original", (55, 150, 190, 245), "A real fence remains fragmented at the passage check")]
    rows = []
    for index, (site, checkpoint, appearance, box, note) in enumerate(cases):
        source = Path(f"C:/Users/Skyri/AppData/Local/FoundryVTT/Data/assets/maps/encounters/{site}/source.png")
        original = Image.open(source).convert("RGB").crop(box)
        overlay = original.copy()
        folder = BASE / f"outputs/Encounter ML review/v16-validation-{checkpoint}-{appearance}"
        detection = read(folder / f"{site}-detection.json")
        local = ImageDraw.Draw(overlay)
        for key, color in (("windows", "yellow"), ("invisible_walls", "cyan")):
            for first, second in detection[key]:
                local.line([(first[0] - box[0], first[1] - box[1]),
                            (second[0] - box[0], second[1] - box[1])], fill=color, width=1)
        y = 35 + index * 310
        draw.text((10, y), f"{site} / {checkpoint} / {appearance}: {note}", font=font, fill="white")
        for x, image in ((10, original), (510, overlay)):
            enlarged = image.resize((image.width * 2, image.height * 2), Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
            canvas.paste(enlarged, (x, y + 29))
        rows.append({"site": site, "checkpoint": checkpoint, "appearance": appearance,
                     "source": artifact(source), "source_crop": box, "note": note,
                     "detection": artifact(folder / f"{site}-detection.json")})
    path = WORK / "v16-critical-native-review.bmp"
    canvas.save(path)

            "right": "Original source with predicted windows in yellow and movement-only segments in cyan; model input appearance is stated per row",
            "rows": rows, "scope": "Selected failure review only; no new training labels or pseudo-labels."}

                       "image": artifact(sample["image"]), "mask": artifact(sample["mask"])})
    sources = {}

        content = subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{REFERENCE}:{name.replace(chr(92), '/')}"],
                                 cwd=REPO, check=True, capture_output=True).stdout
        candidates = [content, content.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\n", b"\r\n")]
        exact = next(candidate for candidate in candidates if hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest() == expected_hash)
        sources[name] = {"sha256": expected_hash, "source": exact.decode("utf-8")}

             "cause": "New regression fixture named light_head.layers.3.weight, but layer 3 is a ReLU. Corrected to the actual final convolution at layer 6. Four tests failed before loading a checkpoint; this was a fixture defect, not a demonstrated loader defect."},

        ],

            "focused": {"command": "python -B -m pytest tests/test_ml_dino.py tests/test_ml.py::test_missing_checkpoint_buffer_fails_before_inference -q", "exit_code": 0, "observed": "8 passed, 3 warnings in 25.16s", "log": artifact(focused_tests)},

Native Foundry export parity was checked offline; no live Foundry world import was rerun. No remote CI result is claimed in this pre-commit record.",

failure_log.cause: New regression fixture named light_head.layers.3.weight, but layer 3 is a ReLU. Corrected to the actual final convolution at layer 6. Four tests failed before loading a checkpoint; this was a fixture defect, not a demonstrated loader defect.

Initial audit passed serialized format/coordinate metadata to the DetectionResult constructor. Corrected by validating those two metadata values, then removing them before constructing the dataclass. No result file or model was written by the failed audit.

validation.scope: Local CUDA development runtime. Unrelated concurrent light-data changes were present in the working tree and are excluded from this change. Native Foundry export parity was checked offline; no live Foundry world import was rerun. No remote CI result is claimed in this pre-commit record.

decision: Do not install v16: the original Mothveil opening/window remain unmatched, recoloring produces false windows on a masonry stair landing, and the fence passage checks still fail despite additional fragments. No inference speed or broad map-accuracy improvement is claimed. The separate output-equivalent DINO loading change passed the final runtime suite and is eligible for installation. This failed trial is not evidence that backbone fine-tuning cannot work.
